first.rationale: Onboarding simplification directly addresses the current completion decline and has prior evidence of improving activation and time-to-value. It better aligns with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, whose acquisition gains came with materially worse 30-day retention. Verification should confirm durability, segment coverage, and experiment design before launch.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow, with completion, activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue as decision metrics. This directly addresses both current declines and is supported by confirmed gains in completion, time-to-value, activation, and qualified revenue. Avoid promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because inherited evidence shows material retention harm. Preserve uncertainty around segment generalization and the SMB signup variant's slight retention decline by using retention guardrails and segmented analysis.
